scope: Deep-dossier qualification of Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation, its former identity, five concrete nuclear, space-resource and sensing technologies, Canadian operating footprint, subsidiaries, current government-funded projects and public institutional relationships.

prospects.name: Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation
prospects.fitSummary: The official site establishes a Canadian space and defence company with a concrete microreactor and broad deep-technology development portfolio.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The official site resolved the current identity, subsidiaries, leadership, LEUNR development posture, portfolio scope and public contact path.

prospects.name: CSMC FedDev Ontario micro-nuclear project
prospects.fitSummary: A current federal award independently corroborates CSMC's Waterloo presence, incorporation date, project scale and Arctic-defence microreactor purpose.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: FedDev Ontario independently confirmed the company identity, former name, Canadian location, current $10.095 million project and $4.5 million contribution.

prospects.name: CSMC IDEaS NORAD modernization LEUNR project
prospects.fitSummary: The National Defence grant record anchors LEUNR directly to an active NORAD-modernization research challenge and Arctic operational-energy need.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The official grant record resolved the defence challenge, funding amount, project dates, recipient identity and intended Arctic operational-energy context.

prospects.name: CSMC Canadian Space Agency technology portfolio
prospects.fitSummary: Multiple CSA pages independently support LunaPure, HYDRO+, LEUNR and current lunar architecture-study activity under the former and current company names.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: CSA program pages resolved the name continuity and four distinct technology or study activities across water, resources and surface power.

prospects.name: CSMC Lunar Surface Exploration Initiative contract
prospects.fitSummary: The procurement record confirms a competitively awarded Canadian Space Agency research contract and the operating name CSMC under the former legal identity.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: CanadaBuys resolved the contracting authority, buying organization, competitive method, duration, address and amended value for contract CW2233478.

prospects.name: CSMC identity continuity and QASM quantum-sensing activity
prospects.fitSummary: The federal trademark record resolves the legal-name transition and technology classes, while the attributed company announcement provides the current QASM contract trail.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The federal record confirmed the former-to-current name change and nuclear, quantum, aerospace and geophysical goods and services associated with the company.
